components.name: Frame
components.summary: There is no top bar: the Page runs the full height, and meets a docked Sidebar at its 1px edge. - The Frame owns the Sidebar state and hands it to the Sidebar through `SidebarControlContext`. Open, the toggle (`angles-left`) ends the Sidebar's logo row; closed, the Frame draws it (`bars`) at the Page's top left, centered on x 32, and the Page's header row (`header`, the breadcrumb) follows it on the same center line from x 56. - What docks is decided by the layout resolver (`./frameLayout`) from the Frame's own width: from 1024 the Sidebar docks (240, in flow); under 1024 it never docks. - Docked, the Sidebar sits on the sunken fill with a 1px `--ds-border` on its Page-facing edge. Floating (a peek, or opened by hand under 1024) it lies over the Page on `--ds-surface-overlay` with `--ds-shadow-overlay` and no Backdrop. - Hovering the left edge peeks a closed Sidebar. An outside press, Escape, or the pointer leaving closes the peek. - Either toggle, or Ctrl+[ (Cmd+[ on a Mac), closes a showing Sidebar and opens a closed one; focus follows to the toggle that is left. - Opening a modal closes a floating Sidebar and leaves a docked one alone, and while one is open the Sidebar does not peek. The frame hears it from the shared overlay module (`@/lib/overlay`), so a page does not wire its modals to the frame. A modal opened from inside the floating Sidebar hands focus to the toggle when it closes, since its trigger left with the Sidebar. - The Panel area (`panel`) is the Frame's right-hand area. The resolver docks it beside the Page at a hairline when the content keeps 720, collapsing a default Sidebar first (and restoring it when the Panel closes); otherwise it floats over the Page on the overlay fill and shadow, with no Backdrop, and a press outside or Escape closes it. Under 1024 it is an overlay capped at 320, and only one overlay is open at a time; under 768 it is full width. As an overlay the Panel is modal: focus moves into it and stays there, the Page and the Sidebar under it are inert, and closing it hands focus back to what opened it. Docked or peeking it is not modal and leaves focus where it is. Its open state, dismissal and focus run on Base UI's `Dialog`, portaled into the Frame's row so a dock or overlay switch never remounts the Panel's content. Its splitter resizes it from 320 to 640 (never past what keeps 720 beside a docked Sidebar) by drag or keys. Width and open state are kept in sessionStorage. A modal leaves it open. Anything inside the Frame opens it through `usePanelControl`. - There is no top bar on any Frame. A focused page (no Sidebar) puts Back (`onBack`, leading) and Close (`onClose`, trailing) in the Page's header row, around the `header` content. - Landmarks: the Page is `main`; the Sidebar's `nav` is the navigation; the Panel is a complementary landmark named by `panelLabel`. - The Page pads `--page-pad` (24 at every width) and caps its content at `--content-max-width` (1232), centered, on a 12-column grid with a 16 gutter. Children span all 12 columns unless they set `grid-column`.

Confirm and cancel buttons sit under the edit view and can be left off. `validate` can refuse a value with a message, and the editor stays open. The parent holds the value. `defaultValue` is what the edit view starts with each time it opens, and `onConfirm` is where the new value goes. Not for use inside a form: it saves on its own and has no say in the form's submit. Use `Input` there.

components.name: PatternSidebar
components.summary: Sidebar pattern: the app's side navigation, 240 wide, padded 12, on the sunken fill. Every row sits on one grid: rows 32 high from x 12 to 228 with radius 6, a 24 icon slot centered on x 32, the label on x 48, and a trailing slot centered on x 208. - **Logo row**: the PLUS Logo lockup at height 24, a link to Home, and the sidebar toggle (`angles-left`) on the trailing column. Inside a Frame the toggle comes from the Frame; standalone, pass `onToggle`. - **Groups**: the first has no title (Home, Slack). Every other group has a title row, a full 32 row that collapses its group; an `angle-down` shows after the title on hover and focus and turns right while collapsed. Each person's collapsed sections are remembered in localStorage. - **Locked group**: while `modulesLeft` is above 0, a group marked `lockedDuringOnboarding` shows a lock in the title's caret slot, its rows in the subtlest text with no hover, and the tooltip "Complete your assigned training to unlock the Toolkit" (no number). It neither collapses nor opens. - **Training counts**: a row with `training: 'lessons'` shows the Count tag of `lessonsLeft` ("2 assigned lessons left"); `training: 'modules'` shows `modulesLeft` ("3 onboarding modules left"), only while onboarding is in progress. Zero shows nothing. - **Trailing slot**: a count, a dot, the external icon for a link that leaves the app, or a close button. - **Open tabs** (`tabs[item.id]`): records a person opened (a session, a student) list under their row on a thread, one line on the icon column whose last row turns into the label column. Each tab shows a live dot at rest and Close on hover, focus and while selected; Delete or Backspace closes the focused tab. Three show, then "Show n more". On hover the row's icon slot turns into a collapse angle and its trailing slot into Close all. Exactly one row is selected: a selected tab takes the fill and its row goes to ink; collapsed, the row takes the fill and shows the tab count. - **Icons**: every row icon is outlined (Font Awesome Free regular) in the one subtle icon color. A selected row shows the fill and the selected icon color, never a solid icon; a brand mark (`fa-brands fa-slack`) is the only exception. - **Account row**: `SidebarAccount`, under a divider. Content is data. The pattern draws what it is given and never changes the URL; which groups a role sees is the caller's config.

The table itself is no-fill (transparent): the surrounding card or surface provides the background, and row states are layered over each cell's fill rather than replacing it. - **Row states**: hovered and pressed rows take the neutral subtle steps; a row with `aria-selected="true"` (in a `role="grid"` table) takes the selected ladder across the whole row, with no stripe on its leading edge; the row's checkbox is the cue that does not rest on color. - **Sticky cells**: `stickyHeader` pins the head row and `stickyColumn` the first column. They paint the current surface, so they match the page or the card they sit in, and take the overflow shadow only while content is scrolled under them. `stickyHeader` pairs with `maxHeight`: only a bounded region scrolls vertically, so without `maxHeight` the header is not pinned. A bounded region, or one with a sticky column, takes keyboard focus so it can be scrolled without a pointer. Mirrors the "Table" slot component in the Figma design system file.

components.name: TagInput
components.summary: TagInput — a field of Tags with a text entry after them, modeled on Notion's multi-select. Focusing the field opens a list of the options. Typing filters it and highlights the first match; Enter or a click adds the highlighted option. A "Create *text*" row is offered when no option matches the text exactly, ignoring case. It previews the new tag as the Tag it will be, in the random Tag color it will get, and creating reports that color once through `onCreate`. Backspace in an empty entry removes the last tag, and Esc closes the list and clears only the typed text. People can tidy the options where they pick them, as in Notion. With `onRename`, `onDelete` or `onColorChange`, the highlighted row shows a "…" that opens the option's menu: its name, Delete, and Tag's ten colors. With `onReorder`, each row has a handle to drag, or to pick up with Space and move with the arrows. Without these handlers neither appears. Built on the shared parts: `_Field` is the box, `Listbox` the list and its rows, and the chips are Tags in a TagGroup. Without focus the tags collapse into "+n"; with focus they wrap, up to three rows, then scroll.

props.name: errorMessage

components.name: TextField

components.summary: Tile: a small square frame that holds a logo, thumbnail or icon standing for a thing.

props.name: content
props.description: What the tile frames. Icons and logos are inset; an image fills and crops.

props.name: size
props.description: 16, 20, 24, 32, 40 or 48, for every kind of content.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Icons only. `subtle` is the color's container; `bold` is the solid color.

props.name: color
props.description: A category color from the Tag set. `white` is for logos. Defaults to white for a logo, gray otherwise.

props.name: icon
props.description: `icon` only: a Font Awesome Free name (`book-open`), a class list, or a node.

props.name: src
props.description: `logo` or `image`: the picture's URL.

props.name: children
props.description: `logo` or `image`: the picture as a node, in place of `src`.

props.name: hasBorder
props.description: Adds a 1px border inside the tile.

props.name: label
props.description: Makes the tile an image with this name. Without it the tile is decorative and hidden.

components.name: TimePicker
components.summary: TimePicker — a time field: type a time, or pick one from the list of the day's times under it (Figma `Time picker`). It is the PLUS Select, searchable: the field is the shared `FieldBox`, the list is the shared `Listbox`, so the box, the list, the keyboard and every state are Select's. There is no separate AM/PM control: each time in the list carries its own period, and typing "2:30p" or "1430" finds it. - **List:** `times`, 24-hour `HH:mm` strings, every half hour by default, shown as "2:30 PM". Typing filters it. - **Typing a time that is not in the list** (`timeIsEditable`, on by default): Enter on the "Create" row reads it — "9:05", "905a", "21:05" — and picks it. Text that is not a real time is refused and the field is marked invalid. - **Value:** a 12-hour string, "02:30 PM", or null once cleared. A 24-hour `value` ("14:30") is accepted and read the same way. Props it does not name (`aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `data-*`) go to the combobox, which is the control a screen reader lands on: TimePicker has no `label` prop, so that is how a caller names it.

props.name: id
props.description: The `id` of the combobox input.

props.name: name
props.description: Submitted with a form, as the 12-hour value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Defaults to `__ : __`.

props.name: value
props.description: A 12-hour string ("02:30 PM") or a 24-hour one ("14:30").

props.name: times
props.description: The times the list offers, as 24-hour `HH:mm`. Every half hour of the day by default.

props.name: timeIsEditable
props.description: Lets a typed time that is not in the list be picked. On by default.

props.name: spacing
props.description: `default` is 40; `compact` is 32.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims the field and blocks opening and changing it.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Shows the time without letting the user change it.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Draws the field invalid; a typed text that is not a time does too.

props.name: isValid
props.description: Draws the field valid.

props.name: onChange
props.description: `(value)` — a 12-hour string, "02:30 PM", or null once cleared.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus entering the field from outside it.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Focus leaving the field and its list.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names on the field's wrapper, beside its own.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the field's wrapper.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: Toggle — turns one setting on or off, and the change takes effect at once. Controlled with `isChecked` or uncontrolled with `defaultChecked`. Built on Base UI's Switch: a `role="switch"` span with a hidden checkbox beside it for form submission. `readOnly` blocks the change at the root, so no hand-rolled click guard is needed. Extra attributes (`aria-label`, `aria-describedby`) go to the switch root.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the switch, which the label points at. A generated id is used when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: Form key sent with the hidden checkbox and reported in `onChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text beside the track. Where the label sits elsewhere, leave it out and pass `aria-label`.

props.name: value
props.description: Form value sent when the toggle is on, and reported as `target.value` in `onChange`. Defaults to `on`.

props.name: isChecked
props.description: Controlled on or off state. Pair it with `onChange`; when it is set, `defaultChecked` is ignored.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state of an uncontrolled toggle.

props.name: size
props.description: Track height in pixels: `16` (default) or `20`.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents interaction and dims the toggle.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner while a change is being saved and ignores input.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Shows the state without letting the user switch it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with `{ target: { name, value, checked } }` when the user switches it. Not called while the toggle is read-only or loading.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called with the focus event when the switch gains focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called with the blur event when the switch loses focus.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the click event on the switch.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the wrapper around the track and label.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style on the wrapper around the track and label.

props.name: testId
props.description: Maps to `data-testid`, for test queries.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: One line of help on hover or focus, built on Base UI.

props.name: text
props.description: Tooltip text

props.name: placement
props.description: Tooltip placement

props.name: trigger
props.description: An empty array or a falsy value turns the tooltip off, for a caller that wants one only when its trigger is truncated. Any other value leaves hover and focus active.

props.name: children
props.description: The single element that triggers the tooltip. Anything that is not an element is wrapped in a span.

props.name: id
props.description: Id set on the tooltip popup.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the tooltip popup.

props.name: show
props.description: Opens or closes the tooltip from outside. Leave it out to open on hover and focus.

props.name: delayShow
props.description: Milliseconds the pointer or focus must stay before the tooltip shows. Defaults to 250.

props.name: delayHide
props.description: Milliseconds before the tooltip hides after the pointer or focus leaves. Defaults to 400.

components.name: TreeSelect
components.summary: TreeSelect: a field that picks from options that nest, at any level of the tree.

props.name: name
props.description: Submitted with a form through hidden inputs, one per value.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label above the field. Without one, pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: caption
props.description: Help under the field. With `isInvalid`, `errorMessage` takes its place and is announced.

props.name: info
props.description: Text for the info tooltip beside the label.

props.name: isMulti
props.description: Several values, shown as checkboxes beside the toggle.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown in the field while nothing is selected. Defaults to `Please select`.

props.name: spacing
props.description: `default` draws 40 and `compact` draws 32.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Shows an asterisk on the label and sets `aria-required`.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Draws the error border, sets `aria-invalid`, and `errorMessage` becomes the announced caption.

components.name: VerticalButton
components.summary: Vertical button: an icon stacked over a short label, one size (60 by 60). For choosing between a few large options, such as a role.

props.name: icon
props.description: A Font Awesome Free glyph name (`user-gear`) or a node.

props.name: label
props.description: One or two words, sentence case.

components.name: VisuallyHidden
components.summary: Text that assistive technology reads and nobody sees: a one-pixel, clipped span taken out of the flow. It is the `.visually-hidden` class `main.scss` defines, which the rest of the system already uses by class name, given a component so the caller never types the class. It paints nothing, so it takes no tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: The text screen readers announce.

props.name: id
props.description: An id other elements can point at with `aria-labelledby` or `aria-describedby`.

props.name: role
props.description: An ARIA role for the span, such as `status` for a live region.
